Name: MagicianWandMod
Author: GoldenMagikarp0512
Description:
This mod adds wand items that allow ranged attacks and teleportation. Interact with the Wizard to upgrade your wand.
Regardless of the displayed attack power, stronger wands deal higher actual damage.
The final stage, "The Arche," provides significant benefits after teleportation.
You can register any location you are currently standing in, as long as it is not inside an artificial structure (some magical locations may still be eligible even if they are artificial). Once registered, you can teleport to any registered location at any time.

Downloads.Description:
1.0.1 – Compatibility Update

• Improved teleport landing logic.
• Fixed an issue where teleporting to modded or altered maps could place the player between indestructible objects.
• Added safe landing fallback logic for heavily modified maps.
